args.query:
-- compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel (user__channel = channel at signup). Assume channel in dim_users.user_channel. We need signups and retention at day 90: from fct_user_days and dim_users
WITH signups AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.user_channel AS channel, u.signup_date::date AS signup_date
  FROM dim_users u
  WHERE u.user_is_internal = FALSE
),
activity90 AS (
  SELECT s.channel, s.user_id
  FROM signups s
  JOIN fct_user_days d ON d.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE d.active_date = s.signup_date + INTERVAL '90 day'
    AND d.is_internal = FALSE
),
cohort_sizes AS (
  SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohort_size
  FROM signups
  GROUP BY channel
),
retained90 AS (
  SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS retained
  FROM activity90
  GROUP BY channel
)
SELECT c.channel, c.cohort_size, COALESCE(r.retained,0) AS retained, CASE WHEN c.cohort_size=0 THEN NULL ELSE retained::double / c.cohort_size END AS retention_90
FROM cohort_sizes c
LEFT JOIN retained90 r USING (channel)
ORDER BY retention_90 DESC;

WITH signups AS (
  SELECT user_id, user__channel AS channel, DATE(user__signup_date) AS signup_date
  FROM fct_users
  WHERE DATE(user__signup_date) BETWEEN DATE('2026-04-13') AND DATE('2026-07-11')
), retained AS (
  SELECT s.channel, s.user_id
  FROM signups s
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT activity__user_id AS user_id
    FROM fct_activity
    WHERE DATE(activity__active_date) BETWEEN DATE('2026-07-12','-89 days') AND DATE('2026-07-11')
  ) a ON s.user_id = a.user_id
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS retained, 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM signups WHERE channel = s.channel) AS cohort_size,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)::double / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM signups WHERE channel = s.channel),0) AS retention
FROM retained r
JOIN signups s ON r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.channel = s.channel
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY retention DESC;

args.query:
-- compute 90-day retention by acquisition channel
with signups as (
  select user_id, min(signup_date) as signup_date, user_channel
  from fct_users
  where user_is_internal = false
  group by user_id, user_channel
),
activity as (
  select distinct user_id, activity_date
  from fct_activity
  where activity_is_internal = false
),
cohorts as (
  select s.user_id, s.user_channel, s.signup_date,
    date(s.signup_date, '+89 day') as day90
  from signups s
  where s.signup_date between '2026-04-01' and '2026-07-12'
)
select c.user_channel as channel,
  count(distinct c.user_id) as cohort_size,
  count(distinct case when a.user_id is not null and a.activity_date between c.signup_date and c.day90 then c.user_id end) as retained_90
from cohorts c
left join (
  select user_id, min(activity_date) as activity_date
  from activity
  group by user_id
) a on a.user_id = c.user_id
group by c.user_channel
order by retained_90 desc;
